meta.title: Unfolded — the folded-paper story game, on your phones
meta.description: A party game for 2–10 friends on their phones. Take turns finishing a sentence and starting the next, then read the whole story out loud.

hero.eyebrow: A party game for friends, on your phones
hero.title: Write one story. Lose control of the plot.
hero.lead: Take turns finishing a sentence and starting the next. Then read it out loud and discover what on earth you just created.

googleSignIn.title: Google sign-in
googleSignIn.body: Unfolded is a party game where friends write one story together on their phones. Signing in with Google is optional. Unfolded uses it only to save your name, email and finished stories to your profile, so they're there on any phone. Unfolded does not use Google APIs to create images, AI-generated content, or anything else.
